P7628.corridor_notes: 16km branch entirely within Yi County (义县), Jinzhou, Liaoning — taps off the Panjin–Chifeng connector's Yixian distribution station and runs to a new Yixian East distribution station. One of 8 branches of the China–Russia Far East domestic-section Phase 3 (长春—石家庄天然气管道工程三阶段), approved per MEE批复 May 2026. Start and end resolve to the same county-level centroid — both stations are within Yi County but a finer township-level split point was not found in either source.
P7628.researcher_notes: Corroborated by 2 independent official sources: MEE EIA approval (2026-05, verbatim quotes 'gate: qi zi ... yi xian dong fen shu zhan, quan chang yue 16 gong li') and PipeChina's own EIA public-participation notice (2025-01), both give identical 16km length and matching station names.
P7628.blockers: Could not geocode the specific distribution stations at finer than county level — no township/village address found in source text or via Nominatim. Both endpoints currently share the same county-centroid coordinate; refine with a route map or as-built GIS if available.
